meta.title: docs: add Docker development performance guidance for Mac/Windows
meta.body_summary: Adds documentation advising Mac/Windows Docker users about HMR performance issues and recommending local development for better performance.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added Docker performance guidance docs; approved by leerob without changes requested, merged after ~6 days.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 6784 changed lines across 200 files, this appears large, but the actual doc change is only 16 lines; most churn is from a merge of the canary branch. The outcome (merged) is consistent with a trivial documentation-only PR.

review_details.concern_detail: No review concerns were raised; the PR was approved.
review_details.performance_claim: Docker for Mac/Windows causes slow HMR; local development recommended for better performance.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Documentation-only change, easily handled by agent; no complex dependencies.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer leerob reviewed the documentation changes without requesting changes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance claims requiring reproduction; documentation discusses general issues.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression as no code changes were made.

core_change_summary.description: Added a section to the local development performance guide about Docker filesystem performance issues on Mac/Windows, and a note in the Docker deployment section recommending local dev for better HMR.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The PR includes a merge of the canary branch, adding 6784 changed lines across many files unrelated to the doc change.
